I'm checking the CA coordinates across this 56-residue chain to identify helical segments by looking at the spacing pattern between residues four apart.

I'm continuing to trace through the remaining CA coordinates and spot-checking the consecutive distances between residues to make sure they're consistent with typical bond spacing.

Continuing through the remaining i→i+3 distance checks, most stay in the extended range around 9-10 Å, consistent with the chain remaining in a beta-strand-like conformation rather than helical.

Continuing to compute distances between successive residue windows, tracking where the chain turns versus extends through this stretch around residues 192-201.

Continuing to compute distances across these residue windows, tracking which segments show sharp turns versus extended stretches.

Computing a couple more distances, 9.2 and 8.97, confirming this pattern holds broadly across the range I've been checking.

Seeing mostly extended i,i+3 distances of 9-10 Å with turns clustered at 185-188, 192-195, 204-207, 212-215, and 220-224, this looks like a predominantly beta-sheet structure rather than helical — likely strands pairing into a sandwich or barrel. I'll go with predominantly beta sheet as the final classification.
